detail.name: Remielle's Namecard
detail.desc: Get by unlocking Remielle's Mindscape: The Garden of Diverging Time
detail.desc2:
A card with one of the first-generation Void Hunters, who is also a former Lieutenant Colonel of the Guard of Staves, printed on it.
Its vintage typography and layout make it look like a prop misplaced from the set of an old film.
The number printed on the card is no longer in service, and the listed address also disappeared long ago. Just as its owner says, it serves no practical purpose. Yet this slender slip of paper carries the weight of an entire era.
